**What it should do, and who it is for**

**Why it is not obvious** — the constraint, the trade-off, or the thing that
has to be measured first. Only one heavy model fits in 16 GB, so anything that
loads weights competes with everything else that does.

**What would tell us it worked** — a metric moving the expected way is not
evidence on its own. Noise is broadband, so it raises high-frequency energy.
